book.title: Jesús' mitya kuinda kenueramula tyee dekeñuba Los Hechos de los Apóstoles

content: Pablo, Bernabéba Iconio pebulubi
Iconio pebulubi Pablo Bernabéba judíola' waku wakudinu yasha bulu devi', yalanu ura' keranguekaanuti depañu, pure' keranguikila, naa judío chachilla bain, naa judío chachi jutyula bain.
Tsenñuren mantsa keranguityu judíolaya, judío chachi jutyulanu firu' depavi' keranguemu naatalalanu firu' pensa kekaanu kila.

Naa tsaañu bain, Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu rukula junu pure' malu chudila Diosa' palaa jelajtu wandi' mijakaakaa kendu, Bale Rukuren tsanguikaantsuñu. Tsejtu Bale Rukaa yalanu tsa tsanguikaatu, Diosya chachillanu estyamuve ti' keewaakare', naa Diosyaa tsanguekaantsuve tyainuu bain, naa keenbashiinuu juula bain ke' keewaakaami.
Tsenñu juntsa pebulunu chumu chachilla pai bulu chachi jui velala, mantsalaya judíolaba bale dejunmala, mantsalaya Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramulaba bale jujuutu.
Tsenñu mantsa judío chachilla bain, mantsa judío chachi jutyula bain debuudi', yala' bale rukulaba dekuindake' tsanguenu deshuwa', shupukachi detya'ke' firu' kenu pala.
Tsenñu Pablo Bernabéba demijatu nepiya' Licaonia tusha miitu, Listra pebulusha bain, Derbe pebulusha bain, tsenmin juntsa pebulu keetala bain nela,
jundala Diosa' mika ura kuinda mijakares neneindu.
Pablo Listrabishupukachi tyatyumi.
Listra pebulubi ma ruku nenu jutyuu chumi, matyu naa-uwanuba netyu, ya' neepa yujka nakayamu' mitya.
Tsejtu entsa ruku chudi' chuna', Pablo naatintsuñuba tejan meenañu, Pablo yanu kata-eetu, uwain juntsa rukuya kerangue' mitya ya' dilu ura' mandiyanuu juñuba mijatu,
daran palaachi tsandimi: Mangujpa', ñu' neepachi uidide, timi. Tsenmalan juntsa ruku uidi' nedundaimi.
Tsenñu chachilla Pablo naakeñuba keenatu Licaonia palaachi pa' jutintsula, tsejtu tsandila: Dyuslaren cha' ruku keraa tiya' lala' junbi depajañuve, tiitila.
Tsejtu Bernabénuya Zeus dyusve kuula, tsenmin Pablonuya Hermes dyusve tila, yaa kayu ura' shili papatiñu' mitya.

Tsenñu chachilla' mitya Zeusnu kalen jimu ruku, pebulu vijanusha Zeuschi aa elesha juñu' mitya, llupu wagaalanu llullu tuti puundene tajitu, wa'namu chachillaba, Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramula' ajuusha yala' mitya detute' keeware' teedinu kila.
Tsenñu Bernabé Pabloba demija' pensandya' llakindyatu, yala' jali dekiyuu chitike', cha' kejtsapala daran pasai vitu entsandila:

Rukula, ¿nenñu dekiyu entsanguintsula? Laa bain ñulla naadejuñuba juntsaa chachi deeyu. Lala enu tsai' jalaya, Diosa' mika ura kuinda demijakarenmala, aantsaa jumulanu demanbashi' ñulla veta' pensa demangue' ura chumu Dios, matyu naa selu bain, tu bain, lamaa bain dekemu, tsenmin jundala tyee depuñuba juntsa bain dekemu Diosnu dekeenguisa tenñu mijakaanaa dejayu,
naa kaspee tinbunuya Diosya chachillanu main main naa naakenu tyañuba tsa tsanguikaanu tiremuwaañu bain.

Tsaaren naa tsaañu bain, Diosya chachillanu naa-uwanuba tiba uraa kiikentsumuve. Naa selusha shuwa juula bain pajte', naa wajka puka bain de-inu tinbu tiyanmala de-iware' tyubanbera fikaren chu' sunden dechukaamu juve, tila.
Tsaaren naa entsa deti'ba naake' jeke uwain tsanguen jutyu tyakaatyu deju' bain, yalanu animaa tute' keewaan jutyu tirekaala.

Tsa denaren Pisidia tusha Antioquía pebulunu chumu judío rukula bain, Iconio pebulunu chumu judío rukula bain dejitu, chachillanu depavi' firu' pensa dekikare' Pablonu shupukachi detya'kikaatu, yumaa peyameete tyatu, pebulu kapasha dejuike' talu' tsuukila.
Tsenñuren Pablo' kelusha, keranguemu rukula yatai deji' uidinmalan Pablo mangujpaimi. Tsejtu pebulusha miitu ayunchi Bernabéba Derbesha miila.
Pablo Siria tusha miimiAntioquía pebulunu.
Derbe pebulunu Diosa' mika ura kuinda demijakare' chachillanu pure' keranguikaakitu, Listra pebulusha demiji', bene Iconio pebulusha manbuila. Tsejtu bene Pisidia tusha Antioquía pebulunu miila.

Tsai' miindu juntsa pebulutala keranguen chumulanu mika', Diosnu keranguenutala kayu puula', ura' chudei ti' miji mijiindu tsa tsandila: Lala Diosnu lala' rei juu tananuya mika taaju i' pulla pullainu detsuyu, tiitila.
Tsenmin kerangue' waku wakudindalamee bale rukula faaware' putu, Diosnu pensangue' panda fityu jujuutu, Diosba kuinda deke' yala' keranguenu Bale Rukaa yalanu kive'sa ti' shuiki shuikikila.
Pisidia tusha pulla' miitu, Panfilia tusha mavijila.
Tsejtu manen Perge pebulubi Diosa' kuinda mijakaatu, bene Atalía pebulusha miila.
Junaa baakunu mavi' Siria tusha Antioquía pebulubi miila, kaspele junaa yalanu challa deke' majaindetsushu juntsa kuinda kidei titu: Diosya tsanguive'nu tsuve, ti', uuden deke' eemuwaala.

Tsejtu yala Antioquíabi demiiñu, keranguemula dewa'diñu, Pablo yala' mitya Dios tyee kikaañu bain, tsenmin naa judío chachi jutyulanu bain tsaren dekeranguikare' livee inuu kikaañu bain tsangue kuinda kila.
Tsejtu Pablo Bernabéba junu pure' malu chudila keranguemu chachillaba.
